methodology_family_coverage.note: No candidate pair has a proven four-tier historical classification, so assigning a methodology family would invent taxonomy. Family coverage is therefore not computable rather than zero-filled.

metric_availability.reason: Exact route is a prerequisite to selecting the mandatory metric set. Evaluating a guessed route would violate the frozen contract.

selection_bias_limitations: Selecting only the 25,761 provisional candidates would condition on evidence/classification availability and is not by itself an unbiased historical universe.
Selecting only eventual metric-complete pairs is prohibited because completeness is an audit result, not an ex-ante universe rule.
Missingness is concentrated in no-pre-decision-evidence and unresolved-classification cohorts and must remain visible.
